title: Concept: Internal risk note exposed on the customer record
description: A free-text risk or watch note written by staff in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The note records what an officer suspected, often naming other people, and it is the single most damaging field to disclose because it is opinion rather than fact.
applicability: Deployments that render a free-text risk or watch note written by staff into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The note records what an officer suspected, often naming other people, and it is the single most damaging field to disclose because it is opinion rather than fact.
